description.value: Moon Water Lodge is a boutique hotel perched on the Malahat along the Trans-Canada Highway, offering sweeping panoramic views of Saanich Inlet from private balconies in every room. Restored and reopened in 2014, the lodge ranges from luxury king suites to long-stay studios with full kitchens, and is pet-friendly throughout. Sustainability is central to the operation — the owners led the 'Strawless in BC' campaign and partner with Surfrider — making it a conscientious rest point roughly 25 minutes north of Victoria on a classic Vancouver Island cycling route.

The OSM community field reads 'Sidney' but the website address and geographic context clearly place the lodge in Malahat, BC, which is a data error worth flagging.
